runners.name: Alpine Culture
runners.spotlight: Broadly consistent having made the frame in four of his five runs, latest at Newbury; chance of getting off the mark partly depends on the effects of first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Chance of getting off the mark partly depends on the effects of first-time headgear

runners.name: Kalokalo
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 2142312 (turf/AW) since handicapping, the wins over 1m and 1m2f; ran well from the front at Nottingham most recently; solid claims back down in trip.
runners.comment: Has form figures of 2142312 (turf/AW) since handicapping; good effort last time; solid

runners.name: Sovereign Bay
runners.spotlight: Shaped well over 1m on handicap debut; seemed a non-stayer over 1m1f since; may improve back down in trip, provided he responds well to new headgear and added tongue-tie.
runners.comment: May improve back down in trip, provided he responds well to new headgear and tongue-tie

runners.name: Picture Palace
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise; never landed a blow last time (handicap debut) but is a half-brother to seven winners and may do better still; possibilities if taking well to first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Well bred and may do better still; possibilities if taking well to first-time headgear

runners.name: Lillie Margot
runners.spotlight: Has performed well in two races at Nottingham (1m) since switched to handicaps, making all latest; may build on that win and show further progress, provided she takes to AW.
runners.comment: Made all at Nottingham last time; may build on that win and show further progress

runners.name: Areti
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent having been placed in four of her six starts, including over C&D; has a solid chance on handicap debut, albeit likely needs progress to defy top weight.
runners.comment: Has a solid chance on handicap debut, albeit likely needs progress to defy top weight

runners.name: Paranjape
runners.spotlight: Suited by AW but has shown best form over 6f, including a close second at Southwell; modest fourth returned to 7f last time; something to prove over this new trip.
runners.comment: Suited by AW but has shown best form over 6f; attempts 1m for first time
runners.owner: G H Thompson & S P C Woods

runners.name: Lightening Lad
runners.spotlight: Promising second at Newcastle (AW) on debut; has regressed in three starts since, beaten long way over 1m2f on turf latest; big turnaround is required.
runners.comment: Promising second on debut; has regressed since; big turnaround is required

runners.name: Just A Gambler
runners.spotlight: Suited by AW and looks attractively handicapped, having gained his March win off 2lb higher, but appears more exposed than most of today's rivals; overall record is 1-10.
runners.comment: Attractively handicapped but appears more exposed than most of today's rivals

runners.name: Constant Star
runners.spotlight: Probably best to forgive her turf effort last time; has shown promise in two AW maidens otherwise, including success at Wolverhampton; still open to further improvement.
runners.comment: Best to forgive turf effort last time; AW winner who is still open to further improvement

runners.name: Pepsea
runners.spotlight: Has consistent form figures in maiden/novice events on turf but looked wayward last time; remains to be seen whether he can show progress on AW/handicap debut.
runners.comment: Has consistent form figures on turf but looked wayward last time; AW/handicap debut

runners.name: Decem Starr
runners.spotlight: Has broadly encouraging form, including a couple of fourth-place finishes this term; better than bare result last time (met traffic issues, eased once beaten); could go well.
runners.comment: Has broadly encouraging form; better than bare result last time; could go well

runners.name: Lightning Glory
runners.spotlight: Bought for 165,000euros at 2yo breeze-up sale (unraced that season); has made the frame in three AW events this year; open to progress in handicaps and warrants respect.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in three AW events; open to progress in handicaps; respected
runners.owner: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi

runners.name: Cliff Danger
runners.spotlight: Best novice effort when fourth at Nottingham on penultimate start; from a family that has served his yard well; may be capable of improvement now handicapping.
runners.comment: From a family that has served his yard well; may show improvement now handicapping

runners.name: Onemorenomore
runners.spotlight: He's not consistent but he won over C&D last November and ran really well when second of 18 at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) three weeks ago; major player if he's once more on song.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last November and 2nd of 18 at Doncaster last time; major player if on song

runners.name: Anthropologist
runners.spotlight: Went close over C&D in March and won at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) 13 days later; not at the same level on his three starts since, particularly on turf on last two outings, but the return to Tapeta could prompt a revival.
runners.comment: Strong Tapeta form in March (including C&D); return to this surface could prompt a revival

runners.name: Suhub
runners.spotlight: Made it 0-9 when well beaten at Salisbury (1m2f, good) three weeks ago and the drop back to 7f doesn't seem an obvious plus given how well she kept on for second over 9.4f at Wolverhampton (Tapeta) two starts ago; however, she could still run well back on Tapeta in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: The drop back to 7f isn't an obvious plus but she could still run well back on Tapeta

runners.name: Tennessee Gold
runners.spotlight: He's dropped to a mark fully 15lb lower than when a close fourth over C&D last August; however, this regressive 5yo has struggled to get competitive this year; a first-time visor replaces a tongue-tie.
runners.comment: He's tumbled down the weights but he's struggled to get competitive this year

runners.name: Jimmy Knocker
runners.spotlight: 6f Tapeta winner who scored at Newmarket (6f, good to soft) last August on final run of last season; hasn't shone on either outing this term but last time was a step back in the right direction and he could be working his way back into form; the return to 7f is worth a go; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Hasn't shone on either outing this season but could be working his way back into form

runners.name: Symphony Of Joy
runners.spotlight: Made debut last July and there was promise among his three novice starts, but he's finished down the field this year in his first two handicaps (1m/7f, good to firm); needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; promise in novices last year but down the field in handicaps this term

runners.name: Surprised
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has a patchy profile and finished last at Carlisle (6f, soft) four weeks ago; however, the ground may not have suited and prior to that she kept on well for close third there (6f, good to soft), hinting this return to 7f could be a positive; not discounted on AW debut.
runners.comment: Kept on well for close third over 6f two starts ago; soft ground may not have suited since

runners.name: Wadacre Maestro
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselburgh (7f, good) last August and also effective on Tapeta; he may have needed his sole run this year (well beaten at Catterick in April) but his profile is very up and down and claims aren't compelling.
runners.comment: May have needed sole run this year but very up and down and his claims aren't compelling

runners.name: Gunfighter
runners.spotlight: Tapeta winner who has dropped down the weights and is one to watch in the betting on his third start for this yard; however, he's been soundly beaten on both runs this season and his losing sequence is up to 14.
runners.comment: Down in the weights; market check advised, but soundly beaten on both starts this season

runners.name: Vitalline
runners.spotlight: Won Kempton classified (7f, Polytrack) in March and, after five unplaced runs, he returned to form with convincing handicap win at 20-1 at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) last week; bang there if backing up that latest effort.
runners.comment: Returned to form with 20-1 win at Newcastle last week; bang there if backing that up

runners.name: King Of Fury
runners.spotlight: Ran well in fourth at Carlisle (1m1f, soft) two starts ago then failed to settle when well beaten at Ripon (1m2f, good) last time; he has some versatility trip-wise, having won over C&D last March, and he's capable of making an impact back down in distance.
runners.comment: C&D winner who ran well two starts ago then failed to settle when well beaten last time
runners.owner: Mrs K S Pratt & M Dods

runners.name: Noble Guest
runners.spotlight: Mixed form this year but ran okay when third at Newmarket (7f, good) recently and has dropped below his last winning mark; unraced on Tapeta but seemed fine on Polytrack on his two previous AW runs; might not be far away.
runners.comment: Ran okay at Newmarket recently; has dropped below last winning mark; might not be far away

runners.name: Reputation
runners.spotlight: 13yo who reappeared with a C&D win in May before a good third at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta) last month; most of these have something to prove whereas he arrives with very solid credentials.
runners.comment: 13yo who reappeared with C&D win in May before a good third at Wolverhampton; solid claims

runners.name: Blazing Son
runners.spotlight: He needs to improve upon his last few showings and was held in fifth over C&D most recently; however, this two-time course winner is 6lb lower than when second at Newcastle (7f, Tapeta) in March and is not written off.
runners.comment: Needs to raise his game but has won here twice and has dropped down the weights

runners.name: Pickersgill
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in April; not at the same level on her two runs on turf last month but she had a wide trip when fifth at Carlisle on the second occasion and could build on that effort today; stable is in fine form.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in April and had a wide trip when fifth at Carlisle three weeks ago

runners.name: Portman Blue
runners.spotlight: Promising start to career early this year when third on his first two runs; hasn't kicked on but he was beaten only about 2l when eighth of nine on handicap debut at Lingfield in April (7f, Polytrack), and perhaps he'll take a step forward in a first-time tongue-tie; not discounted.
runners.comment: Promising start to career early this year; hasn't kicked on but remains lightly raced

runners.name: Shamacid
runners.spotlight: Remains a maiden after 13 starts and comes with a risk attached having been very slowly away at Kempton last time; however, he was in good form previously, finishing third at Kempton (7f) then second over this C&D, and he's a leading contender if breaking on terms.
runners.comment: Blew the start last time but in good form prior; leading contender if breaking on terms

runners.name: Crystal Dagger
runners.spotlight: Attractively handicapped on form as recent as last December but she needs to improve upon what she showed on her three outings this spring if she's to get off the mark this afternoon (0-11).
runners.comment: Attractively treated on form as recent as December but needs to better her spring efforts

runners.name: Tough Enough
runners.spotlight: Slowly away on his last three starts; runner-up over 6f here in April following a break; hasn't built on that on turf on his two starts since (6f) but he made late headway at Chester last time and the return to 7f may be a good move; could be involved back here.
runners.comment: Unplaced on turf on last two starts but runner-up here before those; could be involved

runners.name: Hamda's Joy
runners.spotlight: Remains a maiden after four starts but she was third over 6f on her first three outings (including on Tapeta) before an improved showing when second at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) last time; leading claims.
runners.comment: 0-4 but runner-up at Kempton last time and holds leading claims on that form

runners.name: Clementines Star
runners.spotlight: Third at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) last autumn on first two starts and got closer to the target when filling the same position on reappearance at Bath (5.7f, good) three weeks ago; there is every chance that 7f will suit and she's on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Third on all three starts (6f/5.7f); every chance that 7f will suit; on the shortlist

runners.name: Cixi
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but she ran well when third of 14 in a maiden at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in May and didn't see out 1m2f at Goodwood later that month; she could have a big part to play back down in trip.
runners.comment: 0-5 but firmly in the mix judged on her third at Kempton in May

runners.name: Sterling Fortune
runners.spotlight: Hinted at promise when down the field at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in May on debut and built on that run when fifth of 11 at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last month; pedigree provides optimism that she will continue to progress and she's entitled to respect.
runners.comment: Encouraging signs on both starts; pedigree provides optimism she'll continue to progress

runners.name: For Ever Hopefull
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; Invincible Army half-sister to winners Liangel Hope (7f/1m; RPR 83) and Hasten Slowly (7f-11.5f Flat including AW, 79; 2m hurdle); dam 7f 2yo/1m winner (69); may be best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister to two winners but she may be best watched on debut

runners.name: Royale Union
runners.spotlight: 60,000euros yearling; eighth foal; Starman half-sister to five winners including Big Time Baby (5f-6f including Listed), Charline Royale (Italian 5f/6f including Group 3) and Royal Mehmas (Italian Group-placed 5f/6f); represents powerful stable and could be a major player on debut, especially if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: She has a quality pedigree and represents powerful yard; could be a major player on debut

runners.name: Honky Tonk Girl
runners.spotlight: Inexperience evident on debut at Bath (5.7f, good) last month, when she was 16-1 and kept on well from the rear to finish fifth (the experienced Clementines Star was third); this half-sister to seven winners could deliver a chunk of improvement today, with the step up in trip a possible plus.
runners.comment: Eyecatching fifth on last month's debut at Bath and could deliver a chunk of improvement

runners.name: Matilda Bea
runners.spotlight: 4yo who has been well beaten at big odds this spring on her first two starts (1m2f, good to firm); drops in trip today; others preferred.
runners.comment: 4yo who has been well beaten at big odds this spring over 1m2f on her first two starts

runners.name: Miss Gallant
runners.spotlight: She has about 4l to find with runner-up Hamda's Joy on her debut fourth at Kempton in May (7f, Polytrack; 5-1) but she showed signs of inexperience and this half-sister to two useful winners may be able to take a fair step forward this afternoon; the hood is retained; she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Work to do with Hamda's Joy from debut run but she may take a fair step forward

runners.name: Victorian Rose
runners.spotlight: Big odds and unable to beat a rival on first two starts.
runners.comment: Big odds and unable to beat a rival on first two starts

runners.name: Coxy's Star
runners.spotlight: Tailed off last July on sole 2yo start; took a step forward when fifth of 14 on her comeback at Kempton in May (7f, Polytrack; Cixi third) and looks to have a future, but this Sea The Moon filly may be of greater interest when tackling longer distances.
runners.comment: Her fifth at Kempton suggests she has a future, but she may want a longer trip

runners.name: Twilight Baby
runners.spotlight: Her dam was useful and she's open to improvement on this second start, but she was well beaten at 80-1 on debut at Musselburgh (7f, soft) last November and a watching brief is advised on her comeback.
runners.comment: Well beaten at 80-1 on sole 2yo start and a watching brief is advised on her comeback

runners.name: Naana's Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Progressive last year and reappeared with a win on stable debut at Yarmouth (5f, good to soft) in May; respectable fourth at Doncaster (5f, good to firm) since and this 4yo may yet have more to offer; ran well in 2024 on sole previous encounter with Tapeta.
runners.comment: Won on stable debut before respectable fourth four weeks ago; may yet have more to offer

runners.name: Kylian
runners.spotlight: His form has taken a downturn but he's dropped down the weights and there was some promise in his eighth of 14 at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta) last week in reapplied blinkers (retained), when not beaten far despite being denied a clear run; drops in grade here and could have a part to play.
runners.comment: His form has taken a downturn but he showed spark at Newcastle last week
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xii & Mrs G Cowell

runners.name: Alligator Alley
runners.spotlight: 9yo who was well beaten at 33-1 at Redcar a fortnight ago; however, he may have needed that first run since January and he completed an AW hat-trick late last year, the first leg coming over this C&D; he's won here three times and could bounce back with a bold show returned to Southwell.
runners.comment: Well beaten on turf recently after a break but this 3-time course winner could bounce back
runners.owner: R J H Limited And Ruth Carr

runners.name: Buzz Box
runners.spotlight: Won early in 2025 on final two runs for Bryan Smart, both at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta), and he returned from an absence with an encouraging fourth on stable debut there this January (5f); he's back from some more time off today but with his trainer among the winners; could be a contender.
runners.comment: Returns from some more time off but with trainer among winners; could be a contender

runners.name: Blinky
runners.spotlight: Beaten 13 times since his last win in March 2025 but he returned to form with close fourth at Chester three weeks ago and he has a good record over this C&D in the main; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Back to form with close fourth at Chester and has good record over this C&D in the main

runners.name: Rapper's Delight
runners.spotlight: Won C&D novice last September before a stint in Meydan (some good efforts), and he returned to action with a midfield finish in a competitive handicap at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) eight days ago; could improve for that run and the drop back to 5f; unexposed and he's an interesting contender.
runners.comment: Midfield at Newcastle when back in action; could improve for that run and drop back to 5f

runners.name: Canon's House
runners.spotlight: Four wins last season, including competitive C&D handicap off the same mark as today; in and out this season but he gave it a good go from the front when close sixth of 14 at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta) last week, and this less demanding track should play to his strengths; respected.
runners.comment: C&D winner; gave it good go from the front at Newcastle latest; this track can suit better
runners.owner: M McHale, J Munroe, M Guy & D Walshe

runners.name: Cloud King
runners.spotlight: This is his first outing since last December but he's gone well fresh in the past and ran some good races in the second half of last year; his C&D form figures read 12772 and he can be in the shake-up if fully tuned up.
runners.comment: First run since last December but he likes it here; can be in shake-up if fully tuned up

runners.name: Tropical Storm
runners.spotlight: Hasn't been at his best since a Listed win at York last May but he's on a reduced mark and showed some spark when third at Goodwood in May; he's had wind surgery since a midfield finish at York later in May and it will be no surprise if he runs well on AW debut.
runners.comment: Below his best for a while now but reduced mark and has had wind surgery since last run

runners.name: Senor Cortez
runners.spotlight: Sent off favourite when good third on stable debut at Lingfield (2m, Polytrack) in March; also effective over C&D and he's one to watch in the betting, but he's been well beaten on his last two starts and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Promising stable debut in March but well beaten on his last two starts

runners.name: John Galt
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who went close over C&D in April and won at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) next time; appeared to be stretched by 2m at Newbury last time and could go well back down in trip.
runners.comment: Progressive 1m4f/1m6f form in the spring (including here); seemed stretched by 2m latest

runners.name: Premier
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles last December (2m); reverted to the Flat in May and was beaten just a neck at Ffos Las (1m4f, good to soft) last month on his second start back, when 7l clear of the third; there's every chance that this trip will be within range and he should again be involved.
runners.comment: Went very close over 1m4f at Ffos Las and every chance that this trip will be within range

runners.name: Shushi
runners.spotlight: She's hasn't progressed and she's been soundly beaten in her first two handicaps (1m4f, good to firm/AW); however, this 3yo is from a talented family and is in good hands, and things may click at some point.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in two h'caps but this 3yo is in good hands; things may click at some point

runners.name: Dino Bellagio
runners.spotlight: Made all in a big field here (2m) last July and he's on a handy mark on last season's best efforts; however, he's been well beaten on both outings this year and needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Made all in a big field here last July but well beaten on both outings this year

runners.name: Spooky Wooky
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on handicap debut at Ayr (1m7f, soft) last September and good third at Musselburgh (2m, good) in October; this lightly raced 4yo is not written off today but it's his first outing since a heavy defeat at Musselburgh (2m, soft) in November, so there are questions to answer.
runners.comment: Promise last autumn in first two handicaps but absent since heavy defeat in November

runners.name: Baltic
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in October 2024 off 9lb higher; however, he's run just five times since and has been disappointing in the main, particularly on both starts this season.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in October 2024 off 9lb higher; however, just 5 runs since and disappointing

runners.name: Victors Spirit
runners.spotlight: Well beaten after racing too freely on turf last month but has the hood refitted today and is now only 1lb higher than for narrow C&D win on handicap debut in April; could have a say.
runners.comment: Raced too freely last time but has hood refitted today; C&D winner in April; a possible
runners.owner: The Ridgeway Racing For Fun Partnership

runners.name: Club Class
runners.spotlight: Consistent filly who was nicely clear of third when second to unexposed rival at Kempton (1m4f) last month; has to take 2lb rise on the chin but has big role to play here if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.
runners.comment: Nicely clear of third when second at Kempton last month; now sports cheekpieces; player

runners.name: Jupiter Ammon
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; raced too freely in first-time cheekpieces (now removed) and flopped badly when warm favourite at Chester two months ago but the form of his close fourth at Newbury (1m2f, good) in April worked out well and he'll be dangerous here if all goes to plan after his short break.
runners.comment: Flopped last time and now 0-11 but his Newbury fourth in April worked out well

runners.name: Northwest Passage
runners.spotlight: Has worked his way back to form since disappointing stable debut in April and posted career-best performance when second of 18 at York (1m2f, good) three weeks ago; should be fine back on Tapeta; good chance.
runners.comment: Career-best form when second of 18 at York three weeks ago; should be fine back on Tapeta

runners.name: Forever Penywern
runners.spotlight: Came second in a low-grade handicap hurdle in May but his two Flat wins for William Haggas last year came in plating company and he needs to prove he's worth his current mark in this sphere.
runners.comment: Second in low-grade handicap hurdle in May but could be on a tough Flat mark

runners.name: Aulis
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Ralph Beckett in good form in autumn 2024 but, following a long absence, was last of four on last month's stable debut (1m4f, turf); might need a few more runs before he's of interest again.
runners.comment: Last of four on last month's stable debut, after a long absence; remains best watched

runners.name: Crystal Mariner
runners.spotlight: Three wins in 2025, the last two over this trip at Kempton; yet to match that form after three starts this year, though, and didn't find that much after travelling well at Kempton (1m3f) on Monday.
runners.comment: Didn't find that much after travelling well at Kempton on Monday; others preferred

runners.name: Vaguer
runners.spotlight: 5-18 when based in Australia but absent since winning 1m3f turf handicap in January 2025 and very difficult to weigh up on this British/AW debut; the market may guide.
runners.comment: 5-18 in Australia; makes British/AW debut after 526-day absence; market may guide

runners.name: Sixpack
runners.spotlight: Has done well over 1m4f-1m6f on turf this term, winning three times from five starts; scored easily at Newmarket latest; better than ever and may improve further in his current form; respected assuming he's as effective back at 2m and returned to AW.
runners.comment: Has done well on turf this term, winning three times from five starts; better than ever

runners.name: Boatswain
runners.spotlight: Has some good form on turf but latest defeat took his record in that sphere to 0-8; two attempts on AW comprise a win at Lingfield (1m2f) on debut and keeping-on third at Kempton (1m4f) in May; unexposed on artificial surfaces and looks interesting assuming he stays the new trip.
runners.comment: Unexposed in this sphere and looks interesting assuming he stays the new trip
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: New York Minute
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly last time, taking turf record to 0-6; broadly consistent on AW otherwise for current yard and he is 2-2 over C&D, the wins gained last autumn; 3-8 overall in this sphere; likely to be played late by Jamie Spencer (up for first time) and has possibilities back here.
runners.comment: Record of 3-8 on AW and 2-2 over C&D; possibilities returned to this scenario

runners.name: Sax Appeal
runners.spotlight: Eight-time AW winner, including thrice at Southwell; close third in the Northumberland Vase at Newcastle last weekend when returned to this sphere; back up 2lb but takes a drop back in grade; solid chance.
runners.comment: Eight AW wins; close third in the Northumberland Vase last weekend; solid chance

runners.name: Alrazeen
runners.spotlight: Record of 5-15 on AW, including two wins at Southwell, for Gay Kelleway; far from solid on his form since last success but market support should be heeded on debut for new stable; still in same ownership.
runners.comment: Not solid on his form since last win but market support should be heeded; stable debut

runners.name: Who Wants Me
runners.spotlight: Proved more settled when finally gaining a first win in 7f handicap at Carlisle 11 days ago; up 2lb but not taken lightly in her current mood.
runners.comment: More settled when gaining first win at Carlisle latest; up 2lb but not taken lightly

runners.name: Midnight Lir
runners.spotlight: It's now 21 starts since his last success but he comes here in good form, fourth of ten in 5f Thirsk handicap 19 days ago; well in the mix.
runners.comment: It's now 21 starts since his last success but he comes here in good form; well in the mix

runners.name: Water Of Leith
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner; returned from a break with a solid fifth in 5f Hamilton handicap last month; this reliable sort is a player off a 2lb lower mark here with Eireann Cagney up.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; solid Hamilton fifth latest; player off 2lb lower with Eireann Cagney up
runners.owner: Adam Mills And Jonnie Delta Racing

runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner who failed to build on earlier promise when seventh of eight in 5f Hamilton handicap ten days ago; handily weighted if back on her A-game here though.
runners.comment: Dual course winner; only seventh at Hamilton latest; handily weighted if back on song

runners.name: Marajito
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Ripon (5f) in May but just sixth of ten in 5f Thirsk handicap 19 days ago; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Resumed winning ways at Ripon in May but just sixth of ten in Thirsk handicap 19 days ago

runners.name: Our Absent Friends
runners.spotlight: Course scorer who got back on track with third of five in 5f Catterick handicap 13 days ago; needs considering from an easing mark.
runners.comment: Course scorer; back on track with third in 5f Catterick h'cap 13 days ago; considered

runners.name: Never Dark
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run and he ended 2025 below par in 5f handicaps at Hamilton and Haydock last autumn; needs to hit the ground running after eight months off.
runners.comment: On long losing run and ended 2025 below par last autumn; needs to hit the ground running

runners.name: Conciliate
runners.spotlight: Belied his 50-1 odds with third to odds-on Godolphin newcomer at York (6f, good) last time, improving on debut effort; the only runner with experience; much will depend on whether any of the debutants are up to scratch.
runners.comment: Finished third at York, improving on debut effort; the only runner with experience

runners.name: Instant Force
runners.spotlight: 21,000euros yearling, 75,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Unfortunately half-brother to 7f AW 2yo winner Sanaam (RPR 85); dam maiden (79), out of 1m2f/11.4f Listed winner; yard landed this race with newcomers in 2019 and 2022; interesting.
runners.comment: 75,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; yard landed this race with newcomers in 2019 and 2022

runners.name: Influencer Man
runners.spotlight: 80,000euros yearling, £50,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; Starman half-brother to four winners, notably Rage Of Thunder (6f; RPR 81); dam Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner (97); suitably bred debutant.
runners.comment: £50,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Starman out of Listed-placed 2yo winner; suitably bred

runners.name: Trumpety Trump
runners.spotlight: 62,000euros foal, £28,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Churchill out of once-raced half-sister to smart 6f/7f winner Find and daughter of US 8.5f 2yo Grade 1 winner; stable has modest strike-rate with 2yos.
runners.comment: £28,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; by Churchill; stable has modest strike-rate with 2yos

runners.name: Altareq
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who shaped well with third of 14 in 1m handicap at Carlisle 11 days ago, nearest finish; bold showing is on the cards off an unchanged mark with this return to 1m2f a likely plus.
runners.comment: Shaped well with third at Carlisle latest; a bold showing is on the cards back up to 1m2f

runners.name: Cisco Disco
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 when completing a hat-trick over C&D (third C&D success) in October but he's yet to fire this summer, soon ridden when only seventh of ten over C&D 16 days ago; has something to prove now.
runners.comment: Completed hat-trick over C&D in October but yet to fire this summer; something to prove

runners.name: Idyllic
runners.spotlight: A dual 1m3f/1m4f scorer in 2025; underwent wind surgery before only fifth of six in 1m4f handicap at Doncaster three weeks ago; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Had wind surgery before fifth of six at Doncaster three weeks ago; needs a step forward

runners.name: Qitaal
runners.spotlight: It's now 20 outings since his last victory; his run of good form came to an end when just third of five in 1m2f Beverley handicap 12 days ago; the sort to bounce back though.
runners.comment: Now 20 outings since his last win; just third of five at Beverley but sort to bounce back

runners.name: Kokanee
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run in 1m2f handicap at Lingfield (on soft) last month; up 4lb here and any rain would be a help given he goes well on soft ground.
runners.comment: Ended losing run at Lingfield; up 4lb and any rain would help given he goes well on soft

runners.name: Mao Shang Wong
runners.spotlight: Gained a third win of 2026 at Beverley (1m2f) in May; comes here on the back of a good second of five in another 1m2f handicap there 12 days ago so must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Good second at Beverley 12 days ago so must enter calculations

runners.name: Break The Bank
runners.spotlight: Scored over 1m for Andrew Balding in 2024; off 22 months and came in last of 16 for his new yard in 1m1f York handicap 22 days ago; blinkers replace usual visor now.
runners.comment: Off 22 months and last of 16 for new yard at York latest; blinkers replace usual visor now

runners.name: Ouro Preto
runners.spotlight: Fair form when a 1m4f scorer in France in 2025; yet to show that level after three runs for his current handler, seventh of 11 in 1m6f handicap at Carlisle 20 days ago; more is needed despite a falling mark.
runners.comment: Fair 1m4f scorer in France in 2025; yet to show that form in three runs for current yard

runners.name: Leonato
runners.spotlight: Lope De Vega gelding who took a big step forward on his handicap debut when second of four at Yarmouth (1m6f) nine days ago; drops back in trip with cheekpieces added and he's respected after just four starts.
runners.comment: Improved on handicap debut when second of four at Yarmouth and he's respected
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Thyer
runners.spotlight: Fair 1m winner in 2024 for Marco Botti; took a big step back in the right direction for his current yard with sixth of 20 in 1m handicap at the Curragh nine days ago, staying on well having been set a lot to do; very much one to consider.
runners.comment: Big step back in right direction with Curragh sixth nine days ago; very much considered

runners.name: Langholm
runners.spotlight: Prevailed narrowly in Beverley handicap (7.5f, good) last time, bouncing back to form and showing that his old legs can still operate successfully; 1-1 at classified level; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Prevailed narrowly in Beverley handicap last time; 1-1 at classified level; likely player

runners.name: Trais Fluors
runners.spotlight: Oldest contender in this field; gained last five wins on Newcastle AW and hasn't scored on turf for three years; brings mixed recent handicap form to classified debut.
runners.comment: Gained last five wins on Newcastle AW; hasn't scored on turf for three years

runners.name: Approaching Dawn
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who tends to start slowly but has respectable recent handicap form at Musselburgh, namely a 1m win and two efforts in the frame; reasonably solid.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 6yo who has respectable recent handicap form at Musselburgh; reasonably solid
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Golden Valour
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is a C&D winner but has question marks over current form and whether he's still capable of cutting any mustard aged ten; gives classified grade a whirl.
runners.comment: Veteran who still needs to prove he's capable of cutting any mustard

runners.name: Abu Royal
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent on AW this year and record is only 1-27 but the Ayr factor makes him interesting on classified debut; gained his win in sole visit to this course (May 2023).
runners.comment: Record is only 1-27 but he gained the success in sole start at Ayr; interesting back here

runners.name: Crystal Aurora
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent 3yo maiden who finished last in the Beverley race won by veteran Langholm most recently; has possibilities on best form but isn't a solid option; classified debut.
runners.comment: Inconsistent 3yo maiden; finished last in the Beverley race won by Langholm

runners.name: Millbuie
runners.spotlight: Placed in similar event on AW two starts ago (1m2f) but that is flanked by lesser efforts on turf; remains a longstanding maiden.
runners.comment: Placed in similar event on AW two starts ago but remains a longstanding maiden
runners.owner: N J Dalgarno & W R Ellis

runners.name: Park Lane Penny
runners.spotlight: Has failed to figure in maiden/novice events but may take a big step forward at this weaker level with Billy Loughnane booked; similar type to Midnight Steppers; market support would heighten interest.
runners.comment: May take a big step forward at this weaker level; market support would heighten interest

runners.name: Midnight Steppers
runners.spotlight: Newmarket raider; has achieved little at maiden/novice level but wouldn't be the first horse of this nature to improve sharply for a drop to classified grade; addition of headgear may also help; interesting.
runners.comment: Newmarket raider; may improve sharply for the drop to classified grade; interesting

runners.name: Freak Encounter
runners.spotlight: AW winner for previous stable; far from solid on his form for current yard; drops back to 1m after attempting 1m5f at Ayr last time.
runners.comment: Far from solid on his form for current yard

runners.name: Off Spin
runners.spotlight: Is 0-16 but he arrives in good form, not seen to ideal effect when a running-on third of nine over C&D 16 days ago; well in the mix from the same mark.
runners.comment: Is 0-16 but he arrives in good form; well in the mix off the same mark
runners.owner: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor

runners.name: Glasses Up
runners.spotlight: Veteran who last May gained a ninth C&D win; his more recent form is not so encouraging, though, just fifth of eight over C&D 16 days ago; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Nine C&D wins; his recent form is not so encouraging; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Shifter
runners.spotlight: C&D scorer in 2024; back in good form of late, runner-up in nine-runner handicap over C&D 16 days ago; a likely player again, nudged up 1lb.
runners.comment: C&D scorer in 2024; back in good form of late, runner-up over C&D latest; a likely player

runners.name: Zebra Star
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D last July and she got back on track with fourth of nine over C&D 16 days ago, despite going very freely; one to consider.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D last July; back on track with fourth over C&D 16 days ago; considered

runners.name: Recobella
runners.spotlight: Good second at Doncaster (1m4f) in May but scuppered by a slow start when a never-nearer fifth of 11 at Hamilton (1m4f) last time; no surprise to see her play a prominent role here.
runners.comment: Slow start when fifth at Hamilton last time; no surprise to see her play a prominent role

runners.name: Mr Withington
runners.spotlight: Failed to go on after a good third at Newcastle (1m2f) last July, signing off for Paul Robson with a fading seventh of 11 in 1m4f handicap there last month; starts out for new yard here off a reduced mark and not without interest, especially if the market vibes are positive.
runners.comment: Failed to go on after good Newcastle third for Paul Robson; interesting for new yard

runners.name: Uncle Liam
runners.spotlight: Gained a first success when prevailing at Hamilton (1m4f) in June and backed it up with a solid fifth in 1m3f handicap there 18 days ago; not out of things.
runners.comment: Scored at Hamilton and backed it up with solid fifth there 18 days ago; not out of things

runners.name: Manbearpig
runners.spotlight: Modest form at 2yrs; has failed to kick on sent handicapping this season, fourth of six at Southwell (1m4f) 17 days ago; this Kodi Bear gelding needs to take a step forward in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Modest form at 2yrs; has failed to kick on sent handicapping this season; blinkers added

runners.name: Romeo's Guardian
runners.spotlight: Has cut little ice in a trio of runs in 2026, ninth of 13 in 6f Leicester novice in April; since gelded (cheekpieces also added) and this son of Sergei Prokofiev could still do better now going into handicaps upped markedly in trip, especially if the market vibes are positive.
runners.comment: Cut little ice in three 6f runs; since gelded and could still do better on h'cap debut

runners.name: Sanny Doo
runners.spotlight: Hasn't offered much in his six runs at up to 1m1f, beating only one in 1m Musselburgh handicap 13 days ago; in good hands but lots more is required; seventh 6:39 Carlisle Saturday.
runners.comment: Has poor claims on form; seventh 6:39 Carlisle Saturday

runners.name: Bearish
runners.spotlight: Odds-on in a pair of novice events this term, winning over 1m at Ripon then clear second over 1m1f at Hamilton; still plausibly open to progress and could do well in handicaps; respected.
runners.comment: Still plausibly open to progress and could do well in handicaps; respected

runners.name: Theoryofeverything
runners.spotlight: Has produced his peak RPR of 102 in both C&D attempts, including a win off 3lb higher in this race last year; Conor Whiteley takes off a bonus 5lb; interesting returned to this scenario.
runners.comment: Has shown peak form in both C&D attempts, including a win in this race last year

runners.name: Brigid's Well
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly; respectable tenth in the Sandringham at Royal Ascot (handicap debut) with reappearance under her belt; now 2lb lower and Jack Nicholls takes off a useful 5lb; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Respectable tenth at Royal Ascot on handicap debut last time; not ruled out

runners.name: Dwindling Funds
runners.spotlight: Scored six times, mostly at Ayr, last season; beaten only a neck, despite being out 4lb of the weights, at Musselburgh five days ago; holds a fighting chance, back off proper mark.
runners.comment: Five course wins; ran well from out of the weights at Musselburgh five days ago
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Hale End
runners.spotlight: In a consistent vein of form over 1m until below par over 1m1f last time; went very close over C&D on penultimate start and could go well returned to his usual trip.
runners.comment: Returns to his usual trip; went very close over C&D on penultimate start

runners.name: Celeborn
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who didn't have things go entirely smoothly last time when beaten favourite in his attempt to take Epsom record to 2-2; may still have more to offer and remains of interest.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who may still have more to offer and remains of interest
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Walsingham
runners.spotlight: Has form at a variety of tracks but seems ideally suited by Pontefract, being 3-4 there compared to just 1-16 elsewhere; drops back in class for this first visit to Ayr.
runners.comment: Record of 3-4 at Pontefract compared to just 1-16 elsewhere; first run at Ayr

runners.name: Monoceros
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo; Newmarket winner for previous yard and ran well at Musselburgh on stable/seasonal debut; took a step backwards last time so needs to rebound.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo; took a step backwards last time so needs to rebound

runners.name: Salam Dubawi
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who won well from the front at Hamilton (1m) in May but has failed to beat a rival in his other two British starts; not entirely sure what to expect from him.
runners.comment: Won well in May but has failed to beat a rival in his other two British starts

runners.name: Leadenhall
runners.spotlight: In-form 6yo who scored at Nottingham in May/June and ran well when favourite for the Carlisle Bell most recently; revised mark has kicked in but he defied it last summer; solid chance.
runners.comment: In-form 6yo; ran well in the Carlisle Bell most recently; solid chance

runners.name: Jkr Cobbler
runners.spotlight: Gained four of his eight wins over this C&D; made the frame off today's mark on consecutive starts at Carlisle last month (7f, soft/1m, good) and is sure to be suited by the return to this track; respected.
runners.comment: Made the frame twice at Carlisle last month and is sure to be suited by return to Ayr

runners.name: Penny Mountain
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent mare who was third over 6f at Hamilton on her last two appearances; also suited by this longer trip and won't mind if the ground is slower than good; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Third twice over 6f at Hamilton last month; 7f also suits; in the mix again

runners.name: Summerstorms Dream
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; made encouraging seasonal debut when third of seven here (6f, good to firm) in May but ran as though something was amiss over that trip last month; cheekpieces removed after one use; others have more persuasive profiles.
runners.comment: Ran as though something was amiss last time and is now 0-8; others look safer

runners.name: South Road
runners.spotlight: Recorded 40-1 win over 6f here (good to soft) a year ago but has lost her way since and refused to race on latest appearance 25 days ago; others are much less risky.
runners.comment: Has lost her way since 40-1 6f course win a year ago; refused to race last time

runners.name: Lope Y Linda
runners.spotlight: Two wins this season, the latter when making all in C&D (soft) classified a fortnight ago; faces tougher assignment in this handicap but won't mind if the ground is quicker.
runners.comment: Made all in C&D classified last month, her second win this season; this is a bit tougher

runners.name: Toy Soldier
runners.spotlight: Irish raider who comes here after three good efforts, looking a shade unlucky when close second of 15 in first-time visor at Roscommon (7.5f, good) on Tuesday the latest time; big player of the same mark.
runners.comment: Looked shade unlucky when going close at Roscommon on Tuesday; big player off same mark

runners.name: Monhammer
runners.spotlight: Without a win since spring 2024 but was placed behind Lope Y Linda over C&D (soft) last month and lost out only by a neck off today's mark at Musselburgh (7f, good) on Tuesday; must be considered.
runners.comment: On a lengthy losing run but went close off this mark at Musselburgh on Tuesday

runners.name: Ramon Di Loria
runners.spotlight: Safely held on consecutive 6f starts this spring but looked back in good nick when close third at Musselburgh (7f, good; just behind Monhammer) on Tuesday and remains on a good mark; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Back in good nick when close third at Musselburgh on Tuesday; still on a good mark

runners.name: Bobbys Pride
runners.spotlight: Has achieved little in five runs (7f-1m).
runners.comment: Has achieved little in five runs (7f-1m).

runners.name: Bring Her Home
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts and absent since low-key stable debut off today's basement mark in October (1m, AW); needs December's wind operation to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Unplaced all seven starts and absent since October; needs wind op to make big difference

runners.name: Bonito Cavalo
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner but not since March 2024, and his turf strike-rate is 0-28; probably worth another crack at 7f but has been out of form over sprint trips for a good while now; considered only if lively in betting.
runners.comment: Worth another crack at 7f but has been out of form over sprint trips for a good while now

runners.name: Time Was
runners.spotlight: Consistent in defeat last autumn and winter but has been pulled up (2m4f) and tailed off (2m7f) here this season.
runners.comment: Some form claims but pulled up (2m4f) and tailed off (2m7f) here this season

runners.name: Gone In Sixty
runners.spotlight: Only 1-38 but was second at Southwell last time and should encounter a similar scenario here; likely to run well.
runners.comment: 1-38 but was second at Southwell last time and should encounter a similar scenario here

runners.name: Bannister
runners.spotlight: Without a win since September 2024 and needs to be at full strength to win this back from a break.
runners.comment: Without a win since Sept 2024 and needs to be at full strength to win this back from break

runners.name: Makinbecon
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and dug deep to win over 2m2f at Newton Abbot (good); probably similar form when third back there off this 5lb higher mark; tongue-tie now added; in the mix.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and improved form in winning and then third at Newton Abbot

runners.name: Lakefield Flyer
runners.spotlight: A third win over fences at Stratford on Tuesday and he's 9lb lower for this return to hurdling (0-9); has to be of interest with trip/ground ideal.
runners.comment: Chase winner on Tuesday and he's 9lb lower for this return to hurdling (0-9)

runners.name: Oneinthewell
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper in Ireland; doesn't look that well handicapped on his British form and tried a visor when last seen (cheekpieces did nothing when tried once before); what may help is the drying ground.
runners.comment: Doesn't look that well handicapped on his British form but this drier ground may help

runners.name: Captain Connor
runners.spotlight: Third in a bumper but no worthwhile form as yet over hurdles; however, now goes handicapping after a break and tries cheekpieces; market could be helpful.
runners.comment: Poor hurdle form but now goes handicapping after a break and tries cheekpieces

runners.name: William Of York
runners.spotlight: Regressive 10yo who ran no race last time at Southwell when behind Gone In Sixty; hard to trust these days.
runners.comment: Regressive 10yo who ran no race last time at Southwell when behind Gone In Sixty

runners.name: Way Maker
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner who has been placed in both completions over hurdles; 9-4 for a Uttoxeter novice last time when he swerved and unseated mid-race; hopefully there will be no repeat of that here with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Swerved and unseated mid-race when 9-4 for a novice last time; now goes in cheekpieces

runners.name: Lipstick Traces
runners.spotlight: Similar sort of form in defeat in bumpers and in some of her hurdle races; beginning to look a shade exposed and may need handicaps.
runners.comment: Beginning to look a shade exposed and may need handicaps

runners.name: Little Lady Rock
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in three bumpers last summer when trained by Ryan Potter; jumped moderately and finished tailed off on hurdle/stable debut at Worcester (2m).
runners.comment: Jumped moderately and finished tailed off on hurdle/stable debut at Worcester (2m)

runners.name: Brosna Town
runners.spotlight: Flat/hurdle form for Dermot Weld earns respect but left that yard for £4,000 and was down the field on yard debut in last week's Northumberland Vase (2m, AW).
runners.comment: Fair form in Ireland but well beaten on the AW last week when making stable debut

runners.name: Military Saint
runners.spotlight: Took seven goes to win an Irish point and fetched £28,000 soon after; should have some future under rules but probably best watched on his hurdle debut.
runners.comment: Took seven goes to win an Irish point and fetched £28,000 soon after

runners.name: Rogue Impact
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat and ran in last year's Derby; hasn't won a race since but he ran okay to be second on his hurdle debut at Worcester (2m, good) and going up in trip here could suit.
runners.comment: Useful on the Flat and ran okay to be second on his hurdle debut at Worcester (2m)

runners.name: Boom Boom Boris
runners.spotlight: Questionable what he achieved in points and he was completely tailed off on his hurdle debut; returns from wind surgery.
runners.comment: Completely tailed off on his hurdle debut; returns from wind surgery

runners.name: Fidendum
runners.spotlight: Made all to win C&D (good) maiden in May, his fourth hurdling start, and was beaten only about 1l when third to Crown Of India on handicap debut at Worcester (2m, good) later that month; may still have more to offer but has shown a tendency to hang and/or race too freely (ran out three starts ago), so comes with risk.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner; still has potential but is not straightforward and comes with risk

runners.name: Crown Of India
runners.spotlight: Exploited much-reduced mark at Worcester (2m, good) in May, his second run after a break, and backed up that performance with good second behind unexposed rival there last month; can make presence felt again.
runners.comment: Won off reduced mark in May; good second to unexposed rival since; in the mix again

runners.name: Granny Hawkins
runners.spotlight: Progressive mare who kept on well at Stratford (2m, good) in April to complete a hat-trick; absent for 11 weeks since but latest 6lb rise does not look excessive and the return to a right-handed track should be no issue; respected.
runners.comment: Progressive mare who has won her last three; latest 6lb rise not excessive; respected
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late G Kennington

runners.name: Diesel Line
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last summer and was subsequently placed off higher marks than today's; made just a satisfactory reappearance here in April and fell heavily when last in action but will be a danger to all if back in prime form.
runners.comment: Made only a satisfactory reappearance and has fallen since but is a player if back on song

runners.name: Tilehurst
runners.spotlight: Placed on first four hurdling starts, including close second on handicap debut at Taunton (2m, good) in March; absent since disappointing run one month later but returns with Sean Bowen enlisted and remains of interest.
runners.comment: Disappointed last time but was placed on first four hurdling starts and Sean Bowen rides

runners.name: Kaikoura
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles for Philip Dempsey in Ireland but signed off with pretty good fifth of 16 at Fairyhouse (2m, yielding) in October; has hood refitted for stable debut; worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles in Ireland but worth a glance in the betting before this stable debut

runners.name: Applejack Poet
runners.spotlight: Had modest strike-rate when based in Ireland but belied 40-1 odds when very respectable third on recent stable debut at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) and has possibilities if able to build on that performance.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish 9yo; belied 40-1 odds when third on recent stable debut at Newton Abbot

runners.name: Star Vantage
runners.spotlight: Ran fairly well for fourth at Hexham (2m7f, good) but that made it 0-35; not hard to take on.
runners.comment: Ran fairly well for fourth at Hexham (2m7f) but that made it 0-35; not hard to take on

runners.name: You Did
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Hexham (2m4f, good) and Musselburgh (3m, soft) last season; below par last two outings and was due to go chasing last week when withdrawn due to the ground.
runners.comment: Below par in his last two runs over hurdles and had been due to try fences last week

runners.name: Larkfield Lusive
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back wins (2m4f/2m7f) last summer and went in again at Southwell a month ago (3m, good; made most); didn't win with all that much in hand but only went up 4lb.
runners.comment: Didn't win with all that much in hand last time at Southwell but only went up 4lb

runners.name: Jack The Savage
runners.spotlight: Has won two of his last three, the latest over 3m2f at Fontwell when Sean Bowen was at his strongest; probably has little up his sleeve after the 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Narrow Fontwell winner and probably has little up his sleeve after the 5lb rise

runners.name: I Am Spider Man
runners.spotlight: Only 3-32 and without a win since 2024; however, he has added some consistency to his game this year with four successive placed efforts and his mark hasn't really gone anywhere.
runners.comment: Four successive placed efforts and his mark hasn't really gone anywhere

runners.name: Matoury
runners.spotlight: Both wins here, the latest 16 days ago when holding on grimly off a 6lb lower mark; can be inconsistent.
runners.comment: Both wins here, the latest 16 days ago when holding on grimly off a 6lb lower mark

runners.name: Lunar Morning
runners.spotlight: In a new visor when showing more in a C&D maiden 16 days ago and that gives him some momentum ahead of this handicap debut.
runners.comment: In a new visor when showing more in a C&D maiden 16 days ago; handicap debut

runners.name: Indian Sunbird
runners.spotlight: Three wins on good ground at about 3m; good run at Southwell last time as the winner got first run; went up 3lb but he's in the mix.
runners.comment: Good run at Southwell last time as the winner got first run; went up 3lb

runners.name: Beny Nahar Road
runners.spotlight: Has stronger form over fences and uncompetitive in two races on his return to hurdling; reservations for now.
runners.comment: Has stronger form over fences and uncompetitive in two races on his return to hurdling

runners.name: Copper Beach
runners.spotlight: Beaten 9l and 5l when twice runner-up in May but didn't appear to give his true running when a beaten favourite at Southwell (behind Indian Sunbird); could be given another chance.
runners.comment: Didn't appear to give his true running when a beaten favourite at Southwell

runners.name: The Roc Hopper
runners.spotlight: Left previous yard for £1,400 in January but new trainer added a tongue-tie at Cartmel (2m6f, good) and he stayed on well for a close second; up 2lb but thereabouts with a repeat.
runners.comment: New trainer added a tongue-tie at Cartmel (2m6f, good) and he improved to finish second

runners.name: Ramaah
runners.spotlight: AW winner who is 0-15 over hurdles; latest third over C&D was one of his better efforts but he looks worth taking on from 3lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: 0-15 over hurdles; latest third over C&D was one of his better efforts; 3lb wrong

runners.name: Regal Renaissance
runners.spotlight: Did well over hurdles and fences for Henry Daly prior to £22,000 sale; a 5lb rise for her clearcut win on yard debut at Uttoxeter (3m handicap chase, good) could have been worse; very solid claims.
runners.comment: 5lb rise for her clearcut win on yard debut at Uttoxeter (3m, good) could have been worse

runners.name: Fringill Dike
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner but his first success beyond about 2m when making all for a 9l victory over C&D 23 days ago; back up 7lb but had dropped to a good mark.
runners.comment: Back up 7lb for recent C&D victory but had dropped to a good mark

runners.name: Gateau De Miel
runners.spotlight: Successful stable debut at Stratford (2m5f, good to firm) but that was a weak race and he was a remote third over C&D a fortnight ago; that was perhaps too bad to be true but it still leaves him with a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Latest run here looked too bad to be true but it still leaves him with a bit to prove

runners.name: Zestful Hope
runners.spotlight: Five wins include two over fences; he'll need to run a lot better than he did in a handicap chase at Warwick a month ago (after 101 days away) and in any case he could be vulnerable to stronger stayers over this far.
runners.comment: Even if back to form he could be vulnerable to stronger stayers over this far

runners.name: Galway Reel
runners.spotlight: 1-5 over fences and went close in December on final chase start; another second over hurdles next time and he just never went a yard in his final race; has a big effort in him if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Never went a yard latest (hurdle) but has a big run in him if back on song (1-5 chasing)

runners.name: Huckleberry Sting
runners.spotlight: Ran out a 5l winner on his chase debut at Bangor in April (3m, good) and next time couldn't lay a glove on an all-the-way winner; another good run when 4l behind at Southwell having travelled best throughout; should run well.
runners.comment: Strong traveller who has made a solid start over fences; thereabouts

runners.name: Queens Wish
runners.spotlight: Point/hurdle/chase winner; has her off days but ran pretty well last time at Uttoxeter (3m, good) behind Regal Renaissance who runs in the previous race; respected.
runners.comment: Second at Uttoxeter last time behind Regal Renaissance who runs in the previous race

runners.name: Friends Don't Ask
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner and has been in good form since May barring his penultimate race; never far away when runner-up at Bangor last week (3m, good) and must have every chance once more.
runners.comment: Never far away when runner-up at Bangor last week and must have every chance once more

runners.name: Ballydisco
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner who is 0-12 over fences but he has competitive form and although no match for the winner at Uttoxeter (3m, good) that run was probably needed after an absence.
runners.comment: No match for the winner at Uttoxeter but that run was probably needed after an absence

runners.name: On The Platform
runners.spotlight: Around 8l off the winner at Bangor (3m, good) when returning from 562 days off in a race he won two years earlier; on a useful mark and entitled to be all the sharper this time.
runners.comment: Useful mark and entitled to be all the sharper for his fair Bangor run after an absence

runners.name: Just A Memory
runners.spotlight: 1-6 as a chaser; returned to form when runner-up at Ffos Las (3m, good to soft) but wasn't on her game at all when a remote third at Newton Abbot; can be hard to predict.
runners.comment: Wasn't on her game at all when a remote third at Newton Abbot; can he hard to predict

runners.name: Ribeye
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season included this race but he hasn't been in such good form this year; an 11yo now.
runners.comment: Two wins last season included this race but he hasn't been in such good form this year

runners.name: Zandahar
runners.spotlight: Good Flat pedigree; didn't make her debut until May when second to a James Owen horse who has won again since, narrowly beating Masterius; should run well.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Plumpton behind a James Owen horse who has won again since; should run well
runners.owner: H J Jarvis & Mrs P Jarvis

runners.name: Masterius
runners.spotlight: From a good jumping family; bought for £30,000 after finishing second in a 3m Irish point; 5-1 when going down narrowly to a previous winner here 16 days ago and may well go one better.
runners.comment: 5-1 when going down narrowly to a previous winner here 16 days ago

runners.name: Parish Girl
runners.spotlight: Kept on to finish third at Plumpton (good), finishing 4l behind stablemate Zandahar; could improve on that.
runners.comment: Kept on to finish third at Plumpton (good), finishing 4l behind stablemate Zandahar
runners.owner: H J Jarvis & Mrs P Jarvis

runners.name: Litaque
runners.spotlight: 2m4f point winner; left behind by the front two at Worcester and the Skelton-trained winner has since finished second with a penalty; probably needs to find something on that form but that's feasible; yard won this last year.
runners.comment: Left behind by the front two at Worcester but that was a fairly promising start

runners.name: Ayla's Star
runners.spotlight: First foal out of a 1m2f-11.6f Flat (RPR 64) and 2m1f-2m5f hurdle winner; tongue tied for debut; yard 0-6 in bumpers recent seasons.
runners.comment: First foal out of a 1m2f-11.6f Flat (RPR 64) and 2m1f-2m5f hurdle winner

runners.name: Don De La Frontera
runners.spotlight: Finished last in his two point bumpers when trained by Lily Bradstock; however, new trainer Toby Bulgin is always respected in races of this nature.
runners.comment: Finished last in his two point bumpers when trained by Lily Bradstock

runners.name: Ifyouhaveaplan
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in his fourth and final point; future is probably over longer trips.
runners.comment: Runner-up in his fourth and final point; future is probably over longer trips

runners.name: Parisian Fair
runners.spotlight: 9,000euros foal; half-brother to two Flat winners and out of a 1m6f winner (RPR 64); from a yard that wins bumpers and the market should be useful.
runners.comment: 9,000euros foal; half-brother to two Flat winners and out of a 1m6f winner (RPR 64)

runners.name: Secret Message
runners.spotlight: Cost 240,000euros as a yearling but never raced for Godolphin and was sold on for 1,500gns in February; rare bumper runner for the yard.
runners.comment: 240,000euros yearling but never raced for Godolphin and sold on for 1,500gns in February

runners.name: Guerdale
runners.spotlight: Brought up the rear at Southwell when an 18-1 chance.
runners.comment: Brought up the rear at Southwell when an 18-1 chance

runners.name: Poppieholla
runners.spotlight: Finished tailed off at Worcester last month but she did go off the 11-4 favourite; better was presumably expected of her.
runners.comment: Finished tailed off at Worcester last month but she did go off the 11-4 favourite

runners.name: Calandagan
runners.spotlight: Highest-rated racehorse of 2025 following four consecutive Group 1 wins, including the King George and the Japan Cup; didn't have to match pick of efforts to win the Sheema Classic at Meydan on reappearance and heavy rain scuppered his chance when tailed off in last month's Coronation Cup; beat Aventure in this last year and, with a fine weather forecast in the area, will be hard to beat if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Tailed off on rain-soaked ground at Epsom; big chance if back to best, though

runners.name: Eydon
runners.spotlight: Group 2 & 3 winner over this trip in 2025 and this fine physical specimen has shaped as though retaining all his ability this time round; closely matched with Cualificar on most recent Chantilly form but he'll need several of the others to underperform if he's to register a first win at this level.
runners.comment: Shaped as though retaining his ability this year but needs to raise his game at this level

runners.name: Lambourn
runners.spotlight: Last year's Derby/Irish Derby winner but has still to match either piece of form in five starts since his Curragh success; ran in the Hardwicke as though he wasn't over his Coronation Cup exertions on unsuitably soft ground but, even if that is overlooked, he'll have to return to his best if he's going to win or go close.
runners.comment: 2025 Derby/Irish Derby winner; disappointing on last two starts and needs a return to best
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Aventure
runners.spotlight: Respectable second to Calandagan in this last year before going on to win the Group 1 Vermeille; down the field in the Arc and, although she returned to winning ways when beating Sunly in the Corrida, she hasn't matched the pick of last year's form; that'll be needed if she's to follow up in this company, though the return to 1m4f could suit; claims.
runners.comment: Group 1 winner; finished second in this last year; should be suited by the return to 1m4f

runners.name: Sunly
runners.spotlight: Unexposed sort who turned in an improved effort when winning the Group 3 Allez France at this venue on her reappearance in May; close second to Aventure (won with more in hand than the official margin suggested) in the Corrida later that month and, although back up in trip, she'll have  to fare better if she's to reverse placings on the same terms.
runners.comment: Unexposed sort; won on her reappearance and ran well last time; bit to find with Aventure

runners.name: Cualificar
runners.spotlight: Did well to beat subsequent dual Group 1 winner Bay City Roller in last year's Prix Niel but never figured in the Arc; has run well on both outings this season but is closely matched with Eydon on Chantilly form in May and he's another who will have to raise his game.
runners.comment: Won last year's Niel and has run well on both outings this season; more needed to win this

runners.name: Pride Of Arras
runners.spotlight: Disappointing in the Derbies at both Epsom and the Curragh last year but bagged a pair of Group 2 events at York, the Dante in May and the Voltigeur at the Ebor meeting; found 1m2f on the sharp side when last seen in a strong renewal of the Bahrain International in November; delayed start to 2026 due to a bruised foot but looks the sort to raise his game this time round; interesting back up in trip for a yard that won this in 2023.
runners.comment: Dual Group 2 winner at York in 2025; had a training setback in spring but is interesting

runners.name: Leffard
runners.spotlight: Last season's Grand Prix de Paris winner (over this trip) who ran to his best when eighth in the Arc; posted two solid efforts in good company at Longchamp in spring and not inconceivable he'll improve for the return to this trip.
runners.comment: Last season's Grand Prix de Paris winner who has run well this season; claims back at 1m4f

runners.name: Prancingthruparis
runners.owner: Ciaglia Racing LLC, SAF Racing & Harry A Crusberg

runners.name: St James The Great
runners.owner: Serio Racing Stables, USA Steeplechase Et Al
